note: Melee valley batch 2 (art bible §11 step 2): the non-gear items and the three regular creatures. Gear comes in batch 3 (bronze first, then tier recolours per §9). Bog Warden, Bogling, maul and bog-iron helm come with the bog set.
masterStyle: Cozy dusk fantasy game art in a crisp, high-resolution pixel-art style: chunky stepped shading, limited colours per object, a strong dark brown outline, light from the top left with a warm rim light on the right. Readable at small sizes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no UI, no frame, no background shapes.
